svg.title: Growth and no-growth controls under the same event code
svg.desc: Fine P1 FEM modal-transfer scores and mode-one amplitudes for rho=0.001 and rho=0 using the identical initial condition, horizon, and event analyzer. The no-growth control has no raw score crossing, while neither run has an admissible event.
